product_metadata.title: TIKE SMART “Pebbles” Non-Slip Bathtub/Shower Mat 27.5”x14” Rectangular, Non-Toxic, Safe, Clean, Machine-Washable, Superior Grip & Drainage, Vinyl, for Smooth Floors ONLY, Opaque Aqua
features: FOR SMOOTH BATHTUB/SHOWER FLOORS ONLY - NOT FOR TEXTURED SURFACES. Safety First: The best designer-themed slip-resistant bathtub mat - will keep you, your children, the elderly and disabled safe when bathing & showering. 116 powerful suction cups - will not slip when used on non-textured shower or tub surface. 27.5”x14” size fits any standard shower/tub, with anti-slip protection from slip and fall accidents. Textured pebble shapes offer a natural feel and non-slip protection for superior grip.

CLEAN: The cleanest bathtub mat available, machine washable for years of safe, healthy, worry-free use. Spaces between “pebble” shapes offer drainage channels to keep water flowing through the bath mat.

BEST MATERIALS: Highest quality phthalate-free, BPA-free allergen-free vinyl. Heavy duty, lays flat and won’t slip on the tub or shower floor. Curl-free packaging makes this beautiful bath mat easy to use starting day 1. Stronger than rubber bathtub mats, cleaner than bath rugs, the best of the non-slip bath mats on the market!

COMFORT: Cushioned and comfortable, like a massage for your feet. You, your kids, your parents and the elderly or disabled will feel not only safe but inspired by the elegant design and revitalized while bathing or showering with one of the most comfortable bathtub mats there is!
GUARANTEED: We back our products 100% for life, and you are free to return this product at any time with no questions asked!
description: Note: For smooth (non-textured) shower/tub floors only. Give yourself the peace of mind that comes from being safe and protected by this Premium Quality Pebbles Design Non-Slip PVC Bath Mat. Generous 27x14-inch size fits any standard tub or shower, for complete slip-resistant protection from slips and falls. Excellent safety and stability, with 104 powerful suction cups that attach firmly to any non-textured tub or shower floor. Perfect grip & traction, with a textured, natural-feeling pebble shaped tread and numerous drainage channels that allow water to drain away safely, leaving your feet securely planted on this superior bathtub mat. BPA free, phthalate free, allergen free vinyl. Ultra-clean -- machine-washable for years of safe, healthy, worry-free use. Great for kids, children, the elderly and disabled, as well as general use. Heavy-duty and made from high-quality vinyl material, this no-slip bath mat is stronger than a rubber bathtub mat, cleaner than a bath rug and a better value than other bath tub mats. Lifetime guaranteed with a No Questions Asked lifetime return policy. By Tike Smart.
